crossover.title: Sound ranging
crossover.body: In land warfare, artillery sound ranging is a method of determining the coordinates of a hostile battery using data derived from the sound of its guns firing, so called target acquisition. The same methods can also be used to direct artillery fire at a position with known coordinates, so called fire control.
